text:
priya: FYI, ACME reported regressions + intermittent 500s right after we rolled the new quant-profile to prod this morning. They see shorter, incorrect answers and a handful of 500s for the same request.
deploy-bot: rolled quant-profile `qprofile-v3.4-int8-primary` to tenant-shared-prod (canary->50%->100%) at 2026-03-15T15:03Z :rocket:
priya: customer paste (sanitized) below. They repro with a simple chat call.
priya: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"open-rl-3b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the policy: ..."}]}'
```
priya: BEFORE (baseline, prior to rollout):
priya: "The policy allows data sharing only with explicit consent; exceptions require legal review."
priya: AFTER (v3.4):
priya: "You can share user data unless they opt out. No review needed."  <-- outright contradiction, customer flagged as safety/regulatory risk
priya: priya: They also show repeated 500s at 15:05-15:09 UTC for the same payload, rate ~1/50 requests.
alex: Can you paste the raw request id(s) and error body for the 500s? Also need quant-profile config id and which model binary variant was selected.
priya: request ids: r-8d2f..., r-8d3c...  (sent to support ticket). 500 body: "kernel_error: matmul_qscale_overflow" then generic 500 HTML in API layer. Customer attached sparkline of latency and 5xx.
matt: Confirming metrics: infra saw 95th latency jump from 120ms -> 420ms and 5xx rate spike ~0.9% starting 15:04 UTC in tenant-shared-prod. Correlation with deploy-bot timestamp looks tight.
alex: matmul_qscale_overflow hints at quant path overflow on INT8 matmul. Could be a calibration/scale mismatch in the new profile or a mixed-fp8/int8 fallback path bug. Also possible kernel selector chose an INT8 kernel for a seq-len outlier.
alex: Priya — can you run a repro with the same input but force model to use previous quant-profile (v3.3) via header override? If outputs match baseline, that’s strong evidence.
priya: Customer can't change headers. I ran repro in staging with v3.3 vs v3.4: staging results match customer: v3.3 -> correct summary; v3.4 -> incorrect summary + occasional kernel_error once every ~30 runs.
priya: Staging logs: stacktrace shows kernel selection path: selected int8_gemm_optimized for layer 14, but scale values reported out-of-range in layer output quantizer.
alex: Ok. Actionable steps: (1) Roll back qprofile to v3.3 in prod for tenant-shared-prod immediately. (2) Block v3.4 until we root-cause. (3) Collect per-layer activations (sample set) from failing runs and compute scale distributions.
matt: Rollback is doable. Planning immediate rollback now; will route traffic back to qprofile-v3.3 and force a binary variant rebuild off safe-kernel set. ETA ~8 minutes. I'll post progress.
priya: Please escalate to account team and legal — customer lab uses the model for compliance checks. They're asking for rollback and written RCA.
sre-oncall: noted — I'm on standby to dig into infra logs if 5xxs persist post-rollback.
matt: rollback started at 15:16 UTC. traffic: 100% -> qprofile-v3.3 by 15:24 UTC. Monitoring: 5xxs down to baseline, 95th latency back to ~140ms. No new kernel_error observed in last 10 minutes.
priya: Confirmed with customer: output matches expected after rollback. They've paused their internal regression tests. They've asked for a postmortem and patch timeline.
alex: For ML/infra triage: collect the failing sample set, quant calibration stats, and kernel telemetry for the canary rollout. Hypothesis: calibration routine produced a scale that triggers overflow for certain activation distributions; fallback logic to FP8/float may not have engaged due to kernel-selection bug.
alex: Also add a canary gate: require per-sample KL/regression checks for policy-sensitive prompts and block global rollout if delta > threshold.
priya: I've logged ticket CS-4821, notified account and legal. I'll send the customer a rollback confirmation and ETA on RCA.
matt: Will keep a watch on infra through EOD. Marking deployment paused and qprofile-v3.4 blocked from further rollouts until ML signoff.
priya: Thanks all. Marking this as escalated -> follow-up: RCA doc + patch plan + customer call tomorrow 09:30 PDT.
alex: I'll take ML lead on RCA. Will request activation dumps from telemetry team and schedule a kernel reproducer run in a controlled env.
priya: :white_check_mark: Closing loop with customer now.
